入口: GetRotatrPosition() | 核心: MrATANPositionSpeedAlgorithm() | 故障: MotorSensorCheck() | source: sensor_driver_module/position.c

div.div:
去直流偏置
MrSampleSin - MrOffsetSin → |MrATANSin| + flag_Sin
MrSampleCos - MrOffsetCos → |MrATANCos| + flag_Cos

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 308px; height: 1px; padding-top: 377px; margin-left: 335px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
大小比较 → Tan 计算
max(Sin, Cos) 为主导轴
min / max → MrATANTan (Q10) + flag_ABS

switch.text: 大小比较 → Tan 计算...

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 308px; height: 1px; padding-top: 504px; margin-left: 335px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
四象限索引合成
ATAN_Judge = flag_ABS | (flag_Sin << 1) | (flag_Cos << 2)
3bit 组合 → switch 8 分支确定象限

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 308px; height: 1px; padding-top: 632px; margin-left: 335px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;

display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
ATAN 查表 + 象限补偿
MR_ARCTG(MrATANTan) + 象限偏移量
→ MrRotorPosition (机械角 0 ~ 2π)

switch.text: ATAN 查表 + 象限补偿...

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 308px; height: 1px; padding-top: 769px; margin-left: 335px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
极对数换算
MrRotorPosition × PolarNum × 1024 / (π/2) → % 4096
PolarNum = ELE_ROTOR_POLE_PAIR / MRROTOR_POLE_PAIR

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 308px; height: 1px; padding-top: 899px; margin-left: 335px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
初始位置补偿
% 4096 - MrIniPosition → MrElePosition
越界修正: < 0 则 +4096; > 4096 则 -4096

switch.text: 初始位置补偿% 4096 - MrIniPosition → MrElePosition...

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(187, 222, 251), rgb(25, 55, 80)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(25, 118, 210), rgb(79, 159, 238));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 308px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1026px; margin-left: 335px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#0d47a1, #88baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
MrElePosition (0 ~ 4096)
→ FOC Clark / Park 变换 (电流环输入)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(252, 228, 236), rgb(52, 31, 38)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(233, 30, 99), rgb(255, 128, 187));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 233px; height: 1px; padding-top: 247px; margin-left: 5px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #880e4f;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#880e4f, #fface4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
幅值计算
MRATANQuadraticSum
= MrATANSin² + MrATANCos²

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(252, 228, 236), rgb(52, 31, 38)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(233, 30, 99), rgb(255, 128, 187));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 233px; height: 1px; padding-top: 426px; margin-left: 5px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #880e4f;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#880e4f, #fface4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
MotorSensorCheck()
幅值窗口检测
[QuadraticSumMin, QuadraticSumMax]
超限: MRErrCount++
连续 >= 10 次 → 判传感器故障
恢复正常 → 立即清零 + 清除故障

div.div:
MrIniPosition
来源: EEPROM (上电加载)
写入方: communicate.c L407
或 LearnInitPosition.c (标定例程)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 263px; height: 1px; padding-top: 632px; margin-left: 745px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
环形缓冲 Delta-theta
s_position_cal[10] 存储历史角度
Delta-theta = 当前角 - 10步前角 (差分)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 263px; height: 1px; padding-top: 767px; margin-left: 745px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
过零点换向修正
Delta-theta < -1.9 rad → Delta-theta + 2*pi
Delta-theta > 1.9 rad → Delta-theta - 2*pi
消除换向时角度跨零点跳变

switch.text: 过零点换向修正Delta-theta < -1.9 rad → Delta-theta + 2*pi...

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(225, 190, 231), rgb(86, 56, 92)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(142, 36, 170), rgb(242, 151, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 263px; height: 1px; padding-top: 900px; margin-left: 745px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
一阶低通滤波
alpha = MR_SPEED_LOWPASS_FILTER_VAL / 1024 = 32/1024
s_speed = (992 * s_speed + 32 * Delta-theta) / 1024

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 263px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1027px; margin-left: 745px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #4a148c;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: "Helvetica"; color: light-dark(#4a148c, #e8baff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
MrMechSpeed (rpm)
= 滤波后 Delta-theta × 4774.65
→ 速度外环 PID

div.div:
【未展开说明】
① MrPllAlgorithm() (L245): PLL 备用算法，当前代码已注释，未激活，暂不展开。
② ResolverATANPositionSpeedAlgorithm() (L380): Resolver 传感器路径，MOTOR_SENSOR_CHOOSE==1 时启用，当前关闭，不在本图范围。
③ EncPositionSpeedAlgorithm() (L510): 编码器路径，备用方案，当前关闭。
④ MrIniPosition 初始位置学习 (LearnInitPosition.c, 337行): 一次性 UDS 标定例程 (843步 ~84ms)，见专题说明文档。

switch.text: 【未展开说明】① MrPllAlgorithm() (L245): PLL 备用算法，当前代码已注释，未激活，暂不展开。...

g.text: 图例: 实线箭头 = 数据流方向 | 虚线箭头 = 外部标定参数输入 | 粉红色 = ADC采样 / 故障输出 | 紫色 = 传感器算法节点 | 蓝色 = FOC接口输出 | 黄色虚框 = 标定参数来源 (EEPROM)
